issues.where: near foreground, mid cloud band, and far upper surface
issues.what: directional smear and stretched, airbrushed texture with almost no micro-detail, so the terrain reads as a blur or warp filter; the same smear fills the native crops on image-06, image-07, and image-08
issues.fix: rebuild the near, mid, and far surface so detail stays sharp and unstretched in the native crops

issues.what: the storm core pinches into a rotational smear, like a swirl filter; the same pinch is in the lower-middle crop on image-06 and crop U on image-08
issues.fix: replace the warped core with turbulent structure that does not spiral into a pinched center

issues.what: flat light on a featureless blue sheet, with no relief or specular break; the top-left crops on image-06 and image-07 show the same plastic surface
issues.fix: add fine relief and a light response that changes across the far surface

issues.where: ring arcs to the right of and below the globe; also visible in image-16.png crops U and V
issues.what: The rings resolve into smooth, nearly uniform outlines with a diffuse duplicate-looking outer arc. They read as drawn curves rather than bands of material.
issues.fix: Give the ring bands distinct widths and vary their opacity across and along the arcs. Keep the diffuse dust component subtler than the ring cores.

issues.where: crop F, the storm eye and the cloud lanes extending above it
issues.what: The filaments stretch into long parallel strokes and pinch into an S-shaped hook around a smooth dark eye. The contrast between the smeared blue field and bright flecks makes the vortex look warped in two dimensions.
issues.fix: Break the parallel lanes into cloud structures at several scales, reduce stretching around the eye, and carry fine tonal detail into the vortex interior.

issues.where: crops J and K, the sunlit upper-left limb
issues.what: A thin bright outline stands apart from the broader blue bloom, creating a doubled edge.
issues.fix: Blend the narrow rim and the wide atmospheric glow into one continuous falloff.

issues.where: crops S and T, the dark near foreground below the bright cloud bank
issues.what: The shadowed texture collapses into broad navy smudges and grain, losing fine structure even where adjacent cloud filaments remain crisp.
issues.fix: Preserve some low-contrast fine structure in the foreground shadows without lifting the overall black level.

issues.where: crops C and F, the brightest stars above the horizon
issues.what: Several bright stars have soft colored blobs that overwhelm their point cores.
issues.fix: Reduce bloom on the brightest stars and retain compact cores with a more varied falloff.
